text: Confirmed: `Option.__init__` sets a flag's default to `False` even when the option is `required`, so the value is never "missing" and `MissingParameter` is never raised. Fixing now (src/click/core.py); ETA ~5 min.

Confirmed: with `sys.stdout is None` (pythonw.exe) the default text stream resolves to `None` and `echo` writes to it; same for the progress bar and the pager. Fixing all three (src/click/utils.py, src/click/_termui_impl.py); ETA ~5 min.

Confirmed: a value coming from the environment is used raw for flag options, ignoring `flag_value`. Fixing so the env var just switches the flag on and the value becomes `flag_value` (src/click/core.py); ETA ~6 min.

Confirmed: `argument()` pops `cls` out of the shared `attrs` dict, so a decorator reused on a second command loses the custom class (the same guard already exists in `option()`). Fixing src/click/decorators.py; ETA ~5 min.

Confirmed: `Path.convert` calls `os.readlink` and then `realpath` on the raw (relative) link target, so it is resolved against the CWD. Fixing src/click/types.py to resolve the link itself; ETA ~6 min.

Confirmed: the bool-flag branch of `Option.get_help_record` picks the shown default from `self.default` instead of the resolved default (which does consult `ctx.default_map`). Fixing src/click/core.py; ETA ~6 min.
